summary: The About page presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering and software-delivery company, rather than the staffing and recruiting agency in the approved description. It also promotes an outdated bundled offer and includes unsupported company claims, client totals, and office contacts.

Verify or remove those claims and correct the public rate and service-location statements.

Rebuild the main message around the two approved services, and verify or remove the unsupported company claims, client figures and contact details listed below.
